description: This file defines a Drupal-specific Composer plugin class that manages scaffold operations, event subscriptions, and classmap optimizations during Composer events.

classes.name: Plugin
classes.description: A Drupal-specific Composer plugin class that manages scaffold operations, event subscriptions, and classmap optimizations during Composer events.

methods.name: activate
methods.description: Initializes the plugin with Composer and IO services, setting up internal state.

methods.name: getCapabilities
methods.description: Returns the plugin's capabilities, specifically providing a CommandProvider.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns the list of Composer events the plugin subscribes to and their handler methods.

methods.name: postCmd
methods.description: Handles post-command events to trigger scaffolding.

methods.name: postPackage
methods.description: Handles post-package events to perform actions after package installation/update/removal.

methods.name: onCommand
methods.description: Handles command events, specifically detecting 'require' commands and preventing early handler instantiation.

methods.name: handler
methods.description: Lazily instantiates and returns the scaffold handler, notifying it if 'require' was called.

methods.name: preAutoloadDump
methods.description: Optimizes classmap autoloading by adding specific classes based on installed packages during autoload dump.
